system.description:
Will Amp

Your Ketsuryugan grants you the following bonuses;

Crimson Sight. You gain 30-Feet of Blood Sight, a unique special sense, that allows you to perceive creatures that have iron in their Blood (Humans, Animals etc.), even if they are invisible. This special sense does not penetrate walls or barriers. This increases to 60-feet at 11th level.

Blood As A Resource. If you or another creature has ranks of Bleed within 30 feet of you when you cast a Jutsu with the Water release keyword, you can consume 1 rank of Bleed to gain the benefit of a sufficient source of water, where applicable.

Lifeforce Casting. When you cast a Chinoike Hijutsu, you can spend 2 Crimson Charges to use its Blood Detonation effect.
system.summary: 30-foot Blood Sight (60 at 11th). Bleed can stand in for water, and Crimson Charges fuel Blood Detonation.

rules.text: Lasts up to 10 minutes; 10 minutes of non-use before activating again.
